extraction.name: EuroSAT
extraction.description: A novel satellite image dataset for land use and land cover classification based on Sentinel-2 satellite images. It contains 27,000 labeled, geo-referenced images across 10 classes and 13 spectral bands.
extraction.creator: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth
extraction.rai:dataCollection: We downloaded Sentinel-2A satellite images via Amazon S3, selected images associated with cities covered in the European Urban Atlas, preferred low-cloud scenes, and then created a dataset of georeferenced labeled 64x64 image patches that were manually checked.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Multi-spectral satellite images from the Sentinel-2A satellite, associated with European cities covered in the European Urban Atlas.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset was created by manually labeling georeferenced image patches into 10 land use/land cover classes, and the patches were "manually checked."
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is based on Sentinel-2 satellite images and is intended for land use and land cover classification; the paper notes that current datasets are small-scale or rely on data sources that do not allow the mentioned domain applications, implying coverage and applicability limitations rather than explicit demographic bias.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is designed for patch-based land use and land cover classification, so it does not support fine-grained per-pixel segmentation. The paper also implies it is intended for Earth observation applications using Sentinel-2 imagery and may not generalize beyond those settings.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset may support applications in agriculture, disaster recovery, climate change, urban development, environmental monitoring, land-use change detection, nature protection, sustainable development, and keeping geographical maps up to date.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and benchmarking deep neural networks for satellite image classification and land use/land cover classification; also used for land-use/land-cover change detection and assisting map updating. The paper presents benchmarks and states the dataset can be leveraged for multiple real-world Earth observation applications.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: We selected satellite images with a low cloud level; we also extracted images recorded all over the year and manually checked the 64x64 image patches.
